Inputs

Stateful, form-like components: input[[inputId]] stays in sync automatically, and each has a matching update*() function to push a new value from the server (see [updateMantineProps()] for updating any other prop).

Reactive architecture

The two mechanisms that go beyond simple one-way rendering: a generic prop-update channel and a renderUI()-equivalent reactive output. See vignette("architecture").

updateMantineProps()
Update arbitrary props of a mounted component (generic channel)
mantineOutput() renderMantine()
Reactive Mantine output
mantineDependency()
Mantine JS/CSS dependency
